name: Rechnungen & Angebote
summary: Kunden, Artikel, Angebote und Rechnungen mit fortlaufender Nummer, PDF, Versand, Zahlungsstatus und Mahnwesen nach deutschen Anforderungen.

criteria.title: Company data appears in the invoice PDF header and footer
steps: Save company name, address, VAT id and IBAN
expected: PDF text contains the company name, VAT id and IBAN

modules.name: Kunden & Artikel
features: Artikel mit Einheit, Nettopreis und Steuersatz (19 %, 7 %, 0 %)

criteria.title: Item with 7 % tax is calculated with 7 % on an invoice

modules.name: Rechnungen
features: Entwurf → versendet: danach nicht mehr änderbar (nur Storno)

criteria.title: Finalising invoices assigns gap-free sequential numbers
expected: Numbers are consecutive without gaps (e.g. RE-2026-0001…0003)

criteria.title: Sent invoice cannot be edited — only cancelled
Invoice with 19 % and 7 % lines shows tax per rate
steps: Add one 100,00 line at 19 % and one 100,00 line at 7 %

criteria.title: Sending an invoice e-mails the PDF and sets status 'Versendet'
expected: Outbox contains a mail with a PDF attachment

criteria.title: Partial then full payment moves the invoice to 'Bezahlt'
expected: After the second the status is 'Bezahlt'

modules.name: Storno & Gutschrift
features: Stornorechnung mit eigener Nummer und Bezug

criteria.title: Cancelling an invoice creates a cancellation invoice referencing it
expected: A new document 'Stornorechnung zu <number>' with negative amounts exists

modules.name: Angebote
features: Angebot mit einem Klick in Rechnung umwandeln

criteria.title: Accepted quote converts into an invoice with the same lines
steps: Create a quote with two lines
expected: New invoice draft contains both lines and the customer

criteria.title: Overdue invoice can be reminded and records the reminder level
Export for a month contains every invoice of that month
expected: Downloaded CSV has one row per invoice of that month with number, date, net, tax, gross

criteria.title: E-invoice download contains the structured XML
steps: GET the XRechnung export of an invoice
expected: XML contains invoice number, seller VAT id and gross total

criteria.title: Recurring invoice job creates the next invoice on its date
expected: Next date moved one month ahead

non_functional.text: Geldbeträge als Ganzzahl in Cent gespeichert, Rundung je Steuersatz kaufmännisch
Versendete Rechnungen unveränderbar (GoBD), Änderungen nur per Storno
Aufbewahrung: Rechnungen werden nie physisch gelöscht
